description: Robo and Duck are detectives! A mystery box, five suspects and five senses: see, hear, smell, touch and taste. Each sense gives a clue.

youtube.title: Five Senses for Kids! 👀👂 Detective Mystery Box with Robo | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Robo and Duck are detectives! A mystery box sits on the table, and five suspects wait on the shelf. Each sense gives a clue: we look with our eyes, listen with our ears, smell with our nose, touch with our hands and taste with our tongue.

Try it at home: the feely sock game. A grown-up hides one safe, everyday thing in a clean sock, and your child feels it and guesses. Nothing sharp and nothing small enough to swallow. Only taste food a grown-up gives you.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Five Senses Detectives
Five Senses Detectives!
Whoa! There is a mystery inside.
Let me peek! Quack!
Not yet! Detectives find clues first.
We use our five senses.
Here are five suspects.
A blue ball, a yellow star, a red ball, a red cube and an apple.
Which one is in the box?
Clue number one. Let's see!
see
We see with our eyes. Point to your eyes!
eyes
Look! The box has a little hole.
I will peek! Quack!
I see red! It is red!
Ducks see colours, just like you!
Clue one. It is red.
Which suspects go home?
The blue ball and the yellow star. They are not red!
My eyes can see! Clue, clue, clue!
Clue number two. Let's hear!
hear
Here comes Bunny, our ear expert!
We hear with our ears. Point to your ears!
ears
Bunny can turn her ears to listen.
Look. A ball rolls. A cube slides.
Shh. Be very quiet. Listen.
I hear rolling. Roll, roll, roll!
Clue two. It rolls.
Which suspect goes home?
The red cube! Cubes slide. They do not roll.
My eyes can see! My ears can hear! Clue, clue, clue!
Clue number three. Let's smell!
smell
Oh no. Robots have no nose!
Here comes Dog, our nose expert!
We smell with our nose. Point to your nose!
nose
Sniff, sniff. It smells sweet, like fruit!
A dog's nose is a super sniffer!
Super sniffer!
Which suspect goes home?
The red ball! A ball does not smell like fruit.
My eyes can see! My ears can hear! My nose can smell! Clue, clue, clue!
Only the apple is left! Let's check twice.
Clue number four. Let's touch!
touch
We touch with our hands. Wiggle your fingers!
hands
I will reach inside.
It feels smooth and round, with a little stick on top!
Clue four. Smooth, round, and a stick on top.
Is it the apple?
Yes! An apple!
My eyes can see! My ears can hear! My nose can smell! My hands can touch! Clue, clue, clue!
Clue number five. Let's taste!
taste
We taste with our tongue. Stick it out, gently!
tongue
We only taste food. A grown-up said yes.
Yum! Can I taste it? Quack!
Crunchy and sweet!
Clue five. It tastes crunchy and sweet.
Let's open the box!
It is an apple! Case solved!
Every sense gave us a clue!
Detective quiz time!
One. What do you hear with?
Your ears!
ears
Two. Dog found a clue with his...?
His nose!
nose
Three. How did Duck know the apple was crunchy?
She tasted it with her tongue!
tongue
Four. Can we taste a crayon?
No! We only taste food.
You are super detectives!
My eyes can see! My ears can hear! My nose can smell!
My hands can touch! My tongue can taste! Clue, clue, clue!
Try a feely sock at home, with a grown-up!
Bye, detectives!
Bye, detectives!
